# `lazyEffect`

Suggests avoiding exported zero-argument functions and service members that lazily return Effect or Stream values

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Anti-pattern |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377091` |
| Language Service name | `lazyEffect` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/lazy-effect` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

export interface PreviewService {
  preview: () => Effect.Effect<void>
/**
  ^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(lazy-effect): Interface 'PreviewService' member 'preview' returns a lazy Effect. Effect is already lazy, so wrapping it in a zero-argument function adds unnecessary indirection.
*/
}
```

## Language Service Configuration

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/schema.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "lazyEffect": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Oxlint Configuration

See the [Oxlint setup guide](../README.md#oxlint-setup) for installation and patching instructions.

```json
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/oxlint-schema.json",
  "options": {

  "plugins": ["effecttsgo"],
```
